name: "Cheesesteak" Bake with Peppers, Mushrooms, Onions & Melted Mozzarella
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Slice mushrooms into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the baking sheet with the peppers.
Peel and mince garlic; peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons. Add both to the baking sheet, toss to combine the veggies, then spread out in an even layer.
Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over the veggies; season with salt and pepper.
Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until tender, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, coarsely grate mozzarella.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Turn oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.

Thinly slice steak against the grain. Arrange steak slices over the roasted veggies and sprinkle with cheese. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is melted, about 1 minute. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide the cheesesteak bake between plates and top with parsley. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
